channels.title: Invoice
channels.doc: The subject every invoice event leaves on. The event's name is on the message metadata, so a subscriber dispatches without parsing the payload.

messages.name: billing.InvoiceIssued
messages.title: Invoice issued
messages.doc: The invoice is final and the customer has been asked to pay it.

messages.name: billing.InvoicePaid
messages.title: Invoice paid
messages.doc: The money arrived and the invoice is closed.

messages.name: billing.InvoiceVoided
messages.title: Invoice voided
messages.doc: The invoice was ended without payment.
